goal: Fail scanblocks when block filter ranges are unavailable instead of silently skipping them
Prevent callers from receiving incomplete scan results that appear complete but miss transactions
agreement: Concept approval for fixing silent filter lookup failures (maflcko, fjahr)
Unaddressed objection: functional test relies on races and mines excessive blocks, no author reply (fjahr)
Nonblocking objection: checking index readiness upfront may misclassify errors on long scans (fjahr)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it stops scanblocks from returning false complete results when index ranges are missing
Callers no longer risk missing transactions due to unindexed blocks being silently omitted
